_about: Sources for the body and world docs, rendered into ../SOURCES.md (the body and world section) and the dashboard. Keys are cited in the docs. 'opened' is the date the page was read in the research session; 'kind' is what the source is (science | history | reference).

sources.title: Body and world sources (keys cited in body/*.md and world/*.md)
sources.source: Opened 2026-10-29 by the body-and-world keeper unless noted. Textbook facts with no page opened are marked 'standard reference'.
